appDescription: ParkIQ recommends parking near a destination using driving time, walking distance, parking availability and price.

function.name: SEARCH_PARKING
function.description: Find parking near a supported destination with a walking, time or price preference.

function.name: START_PARKING_ROUTE
function.description: Start navigation to a parking facility selected by its rank in the current recommendation list.

rank.description: The one-based rank of the selected parking recommendation.

function.name: CANCEL_PARKING_ROUTE
function.description: Cancel the current parking navigation route.
